game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation, a waystation for merchants: the scarab scholar must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Merchant Waystation.
theme: Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation: a waystation for merchants
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Test dataset 7: {'n': 0}; {'n': 12}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Merchant Waystation'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the sundial using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the sundial is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
